blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets. On three fixed language-model checkpoints, RC-DS has higher mean gain-free reconstruction in all 18 tested task-sparsity settings, while centered-logit SAEs reconstruct output logits better in 17. Small-label-head controls show that longer training reduces the reconstruction gap from 0.0198 to 0.0016. Together, these results show how readout scaling, the data distribution, and training shape sparse learning. RC-DS provides an information-preserving method for studying and controlling the readout's contribution. Separate label-detection and steering tests distinguish these reconstruction effects from task-specific feature usefulness.

features ( Cunningham et al., 2023 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) . The usual
squared-error objective measures how well these features reconstruct the input. The choice
of input coordinates determines which reconstruction errors receive the most weight.
Two representations can contain the same information and still lead to different sparse
features. We study this effect near a neural network’s linear readout.

blocks.en:
We introduce readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates. RC-DS keeps the
retained hidden directions that affect differences between output scores and removes the
readout’s singular-value gains. An SAE trained on these coordinates is an RC-DS-SAE .
At a fixed checkpoint and allowed-action set, RC-DS and retained centered logits can be
converted into each other. They carry the same decision information. Comparing them therefore
isolates a change in training geometry rather than a change in information
(Figure 1 ).
Centered-logit SAEs therefore provide a controlled baseline for testing the effect of
readout scaling. Ordinary hidden-state SAEs provide a complementary comparison, testing
whether moving into readout-based coordinates improves sparse learning in the first place.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
SAE research studies feature discovery, scaling, and evaluation ( Cunningham et al., 2023 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) . Templeton et al. (2024) extend feature extraction and intervention studies to
Claude 3 Sonnet. Gated SAEs separate feature selection from magnitude estimation to reduce
shrinkage ( Rajamanoharan et al., 2024a ) . JumpReLU SAEs improve reconstruction at a given
sparsity through their activation function and training objective ( Rajamanoharan et al., 2024b ) . These architectural changes complement our question about
input coordinates. Our comparisons hold the SAE architecture fixed and do not establish
the same coordinate effects for every SAE variant. Benchmarking and sparse-probing
studies distinguish reconstruction, sparsity, interpretability, and usefulness ( Karvonen et al., 2025 ; Kantamneni et al., 2025 ) . Critiques of canonical features and random-baseline
comparisons motivate tests that isolate why a method helps ( Leask et al., 2025 ; Korznikov et al., 2026 ) .
We study the effect of changing readout coordinates while preserving their decision information.

克洛德3·索内特. Gated SAEs 将特性选择从规模估计中分离出来以减少
收缩 (Rajamanoharan等, 2024a.). 跳取RELU SAEs 改善特定重建

比较激发了孤立一种方法有何帮助的测试(Leask等人,2025;Korznikov等人,2026)。
我们研究改变读取坐标的效果,同时保留他们的决定信息.

blocks.en:
Interpreting hidden states through vocabulary predictions is also the motivation for the
logit lens ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) and tuned lens ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) .
The logit lens applies the model’s output readout to intermediate states. The tuned lens
learns an affine translator for each layer to make these predictions more reliable.
Our study instead starts at the model’s actual linear readout and changes the coordinates
used for sparse learning. It does not learn layerwise translators or add decision information.

blocks.en:
Input scaling and encoder capacity are established concerns in sparse learning. Saraswatula and Klindt (2025) study PCA whitening for modern SAEs and report
interpretability gains alongside reconstruction trade-offs. O’Neill et al. (2024) analyze limitations of the usual sparse encoder and compare more expressive inference methods.
Our comparison isolates the scaling introduced by a linear readout. This differs from covariance
whitening, which rescales activations using their observed variances and correlations. We compare
both approaches and include a control that reproduces RC-DS training exactly.

结合重建的取舍来解释可获性。 O'Neill等人(2024年)分析了常用稀有编码器的局限性并比较了更能表达的推论方法.
我们的比较隔离了线性读取引入的缩放. 这和共性不同
白化,它利用所观察到的差异和相关性来调整活化的尺度. 我们比较
这两种方法都采用,并包括一种能完全复制RC-DS培训的控制措施。

blocks.en:
Coordinate choice also affects optimization. Adam uses coordinatewise moment estimates ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) , and its behavior can change under rotations of the parameter space ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . This is relevant when independently trained hidden-state and
full-rank RC-DS SAEs differ despite having transportable solutions. Natural-gradient methods
address parameterization through a Fisher-based optimization metric ( Martens, 2020 ) .
RC-DS is not a natural-gradient optimizer. It removes gains specified by the readout, and
ordinary squared-error training in the resulting coordinates changes the reconstruction
objective relative to logit training. Our loss-only and exact-wrapper controls examine
both reconstruction weighting and training parameterization. They do not isolate Adam
as the sole source of differences.

Representation comparisons also depend on the transformations under which a claim is intended

singular gains. This is not covariance whitening. The policy setting supplies exact maps from
hidden perturbations to legal logits, with OpenSpiel providing the game interface ( Lanctot et al., 2019 ) . These maps let us test geometry separately from immediate decision
information.

recovery difference, not a layer’s scaling exponent or a trained feature’s intervention effect.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion

blocks.en:
The central finding is that sparse learning depends on how decision information is
represented, not only on which information is available. On the retained subspace, RC-DS
and centered logits determine each other. Ordinary squared-error training nevertheless
places different weights on their reconstruction errors. The exact wrapper makes this
distinction concrete: transforming the inputs, outputs, and loss together reproduces
RC-DS training from scaled coordinates. Reweighting the loss alone recovers only part of
the improvement. The resulting difference concerns both error weighting and training
parameterization, rather than additional decision information.

In the base synthetic generator, sparse factors are formed before the readout applies its

each direction, but does not specify how the data or its sparse factors occupy those
directions. This explains why condition number alone is insufficient. The relevant question
is whether removing the gains brings the training geometry closer to the structure being
recovered.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
Readout scaling shapes sparse feature recovery without changing retained decision information.
The controlled studies show that the generating geometry changes which coordinates work best.
In the base generator, RC-DS improves recovery by removing readout distortion. Other
generating constructions favor retaining the gains. The condition-number sweep quantifies the
former case, and the exact wrapper isolates its training-geometry mechanism.
Real-model comparisons identify reconstruction
gains and explain their dependence on the target and training budget. Together, the method
and evidence make readout geometry an explicit, testable part of SAE design and evaluation.
Better reconstruction alone does not establish better recovered factors or more useful
features. Whitening and raw-coordinate controls are necessary to test those claims.

blocks.en:
The study uses synthetic data, simulated games, and public text corpora. It contains no newly

comparisons and distinguish development from confirmation to avoid overstating capability.

blocks.en: I.1 Software and computation

blocks.en:
The studies use Python and PyTorch for policy and SAE training, OpenSpiel for the game
environments, and Hugging Face Transformers for the pretrained language models and tokenizers.
Game policies are trained before their representations are collected. The pretrained language
models remain frozen. Their hidden states and readout factors are cached so that coordinate
methods can be compared on the same examples without repeating model inference for every SAE fit.

blocks.en:
The 540-fit full-vocabulary study runs SAE training with three concurrent CPU workers and
one thread per fit. Development and confirmation training take 2.66 and 5.62 wall-clock hours,
respectively, excluding representation extraction and final scoring. These timings describe
that study, not the total cost of the paper. Appendix L gives
the model dimensions, data sizes, update schedule, and per-fit compute totals.

每发一线. 开发和确认培训需要2.66和5.62个墙上小时,
分别不包括代表提取和最后得分。 这些时间说明
而不是论文的总成本 附录L

blocks.en: I.2 Data partitions and matched training

blocks.en:
Each study distinguishes examples used to fit the SAE, select methods or features, and
evaluate the selected result. Centering means, normalization scales, and covariance transforms
are estimated from fitting examples. Model and dataset revisions, numerical rank tolerances,
seeds, and split rules are specified by the study’s protocol. Coordinate comparisons match
SAE capacity and training budgets within a study. Paired initialization and minibatch schedules
are used where specified, and learning-rate selection follows the stated rule for each study.
Table 3 at the start of the appendices summarizes the distinct data,
budgets, and questions, with links to each study’s detailed settings.

每项研究都区分了用于符合最高平等标准、选择方法或特征的实例,以及

blocks.en:
The synthetic study measures known-factor recovery. Real-model generating factors are unknown,

blocks.en: Appendix L Full-Readout Semantic Usefulness

blocks.en:
This study tests whether fitting-data geometry predicts a change in label detection, not
whether an SAE recovers unknown generating factors. It uses full pretrained vocabulary
readouts rather than fitted task heads. Qwen2.5-0.5B supplies development data ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) . Qwen3-0.6B-Base and SmolLM2-360M are reserved for confirmation ( Qwen Team, 2025 ; Ben Allal et al., 2025 ) . No language-model weights are updated.
The retained ranks are 896, 1,024, and 960, respectively. The corresponding condition
numbers are 22.6, 14.4, and 79.4.

阅读,而不是安装任务头。 Quen2.5-0.5B提供开发数据(Quen Team,2024.). Qwen3-0.6B-Base和SmolLM2-360M被保留用于确认(Quen Team,2025;Ben Allal等,2025.). 不更新语言模型加权数 。
保留的军衔分别为896人,1,024人和960人. 相应条件
数字是22.6、14.4和79.4。

blocks.en: L.1 Texts, coordinates, and training
blocks.zh: L.1 文本、坐标和培训

blocks.en:
We use Emotion, AG News, and IMDb ( Saravia et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2015 ; Maas et al., 2011 ) .
Each task has 2,400 SAE-fitting texts, 600 feature-selection texts, and 1,200 scoring texts,
balanced across its six, four, or two classes. These are fixed partitions from the published
training pools, not official benchmark test scores. We exclude duplicate normalized texts
and identical truncated token sequences across roles and tasks for all three tokenizers.
Emotion also excludes all 20,000 official-split texts and the earlier 480-text semantic panel.
The same text partitions are used across models. This matching does not establish independence
from language-model pretraining data.

培训池,而不是官方基准测试分数。 我们排除重复的正版文本
以及所有三个代号的 角色和任务中相同的符号序列
情感也排除了所有20000个正文相分的文本和之前的480个正文语义面板.
相同的文本分区被跨模型使用. 此匹配不建立独立性
从语言模型预训数据。

blocks.en:
Inputs are raw text without task instructions or label prefixes. We truncate to 128 tokens and
extract the final nonpadding hidden state before the original vocabulary readout. Centering
means and coordinate transforms use fitting states only. We compare centered logits, RC-DS,
ordinary hidden coordinates, per-singular-coordinate standardization, and ZCA whitening.
The logit and RC-DS arms use compact singular coordinates. These preserve reconstruction
norms and the retained information, but a vocabulary-width SAE can follow a different Adam
training trajectory. Standardization acts on singular coordinates, not individual vocabulary tokens.
Whitening uses fitting covariance with the protocol’s 10 − 6 10^{-6} regularization floor.

blocks.en:
All arms use 1,024 dictionary atoms and K ∈ { 8 , 32 } K\in\{8,32\} . The dictionary is modestly
overcomplete for Qwen2.5 and SmolLM2 and equal-width for Qwen3. Three paired seeds and two

uses 6,000 updates with batches of 128, independently updated encoder and decoder weights,
unit decoder directions, and global fitting-RMS normalization. The learning rate decays to
one tenth of its initial value by 80% of the training budget. Paired seeds use the same
sampled fitting rows for initialization and the same minibatch schedule. We preserve initial
weights, complete training histories, and checkpoints at updates 3,000 and 6,000.
For each arm, K K , and seed, the final native fitting MSE selects the learning rate.
No semantic labels or scoring outcomes are used for this selection.

blocks.en: L.3 Results on the reserved models

blocks.en: L.6 Provenance and internal verification
blocks.zh: L.6 证据和内部核查

blocks.en:
The internally retained protocol pins all model and dataset revisions. Its SHA-256 begins 7fcfe2e0d79652b1 . The source code is also locked, separately from its outputs.
Saved forecasts precede all 360 reserved fits. Checkpoint replay verifies 1,080 training
checkpoints across 540
fits and 585 semantic score rows, including trained, untrained, and raw-coordinate controls.
It recomputes feature selection and exact tied-score AUROC and checks text/token separation,
selected learning rates, source hashes, and forecast timestamps.

选定学习率、源码和预测时间戳。

blocks.en:
SAE training uses three concurrent CPU workers with one thread per fit. Development training
takes 2.66 wall-clock hours and confirmation 5.62 hours on the recorded machine, excluding
representation extraction and final scoring. Summed per-fit training times are 7.37 and
14.08 hours. These measurements are not portable runtime guarantees.

blocks.en:
Development and confirmation outputs come from separate executions of identical
checksum-locked source. Their metadata records the phase and source hash. An initial setup
failure occurred before SAE training and remains in the internal record. Tables and figures
are generated from saved results without retraining. The source code and executable notebooks
are not publicly released.

blocks.en:
The scope remains three fixed checkpoints, with only two reserved for confirmation.
SAE seeds and tasks are repeated measurements, not additional independently trained models.
The outcome is a single-feature label-detection score on the specified text partitions.
It is not a test of all possible semantics, latent-factor truth, or causal intervention quality.

其范围仍然是三个固定检查站,只有两个供确认。
SAE种子和任务都是重复测量,而不是额外的独立训练的模型.
结果在指定的文本分区上有一个单地标-检测分数.
这不是对所有可能的语义、潜在因素的真理或因果干预质量的检验。
